name: 15-minute grocery delivery
title: 15-minute grocery delivery: no-go while money costs this much
question: Is 15-minute grocery delivery coming back?
answer: Gorillas, Getir, Buyk and Fridge No More raised large rounds in 2020-22 to deliver groceries in 15 minutes from dark stores. Buyk and Fridge No More collapsed in March 2022 when their funding was cut off, Gorillas sold itself to Getir that December, and Getir left the US, UK and Germany in 2024. Each order lost money and only cheap, plentiful capital covered it. The board's live metric is the fed funds rate, which is nowhere near its 2021 level.
verdict_reason: The blocker was the price of money, and the fed funds rate is still above 3.5%.

constraint.name: Near-zero cost of capital
constraint.detail: Dark stores and couriers on standby lose money per order at small basket sizes; the model only survived while capital was nearly free.
